title: Slush
tagline: Slush is a cross-chain bridge deployed on FEVM testnet and Polygon Mumbai testnet
description:
Slush is a decentralized cross-chain token bridge deployed on FEVM testnet and Polygon Mumbai testnet. Users will be transfer ERC20 tokens between the FEVM testnet and Polygon Mumbai testnet networks. 
Currently supporting sFil, a mock Fil token created for the FVM SpaceWarp hackathon
how_its_made:
Slush is a cross-chain bridge deployed on FEVM and Polygon Mumbai.
Slush was created using the Hardhat framework and the frontend is created using the Vue.js framework.
The Slush front-end is being hosted on Spheron Network.
Project is built with javascript, solidity, hardhat, vue.js
